tagline: Our mission is to revolutionize commerce globally.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Payment Volume (TPV) is the primary indicator of growth and network momentum at PayPal, directly reflecting adoption by consumers and merchants worldwide.

kpis.name: Total Payment Volume
kpis.explanation: Total value of payments processed on the PayPal platform.
kpis.description: TPV reaches $1.79 trillion in 2025, up 7% from 2024, supported by an increase in active accounts and integrated services.
kpis.signal: Solid payment volume growth despite pressure on unit transactions.

kpis.name: Active Accounts
kpis.explanation: Number of accounts that have made a transaction in the last 12 months.
kpis.description: PayPal has 439 million active accounts as of December 31, 2025, up 1% from 2024.
kpis.signal: Modest but stable customer base growth.

kpis.name: Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transaction fees, financial services, and partnerships.
kpis.description: Net revenues amount to $33.2 billion in 2025, up 4% from 2024, driven by TPV growth and credit-related revenue.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth, driven by TPV and interest income.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improves from 17% in 2024 to 18% in 2025, despite higher marketing expenses and credit losses.
kpis.signal: Improved operational efficiency through better cost control.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income reaches $6.1 billion in 2025, up 14%, driven by revenue growth and cost discipline.
kpis.signal: Strong operating income growth, outpacing revenue growth.

kpis.name: Payment Transactions
kpis.explanation: Total number of payments made on the platform.
kpis.description: The number of transactions declines 4% to 25.4 billion in 2025, while TPV increases, indicating higher average transaction value.
kpis.signal: Decline in unit transactions despite TPV growth, suggesting higher basket sizes.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income amounts to $5.2 billion in 2025, up 26%, supported by lower corporate tax expense.
kpis.signal: Significant net income growth, driven by operating margin and tax adjustments.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improves from 17% in 2024 to 18% in 2025, after remaining flat at 17% in 2023.

kpis.name: Net Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transaction fees, financial services, and partnerships.
kpis.description: Net revenues increase from $29.8 billion in 2023 to $31.8 billion in 2024, then to $33.2 billion in 2025.
kpis.signal: Steady revenue growth over three years.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL data over the last 6 reported fiscal years (10-K filings).
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $33.172 Bn in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Transaction Losses
risks.score_rationale: Transaction losses fluctuate based on numerous factors, including macroeconomic conditions and the credit quality of loans

risks.title: Tax Risks
risks.score_rationale: Tax laws are complex and subject to different interpretations, which may lead to uncertainties

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: Loans and interest income are exposed to credit risks, which may vary depending on macroeconomic conditions

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates can impact the value of investments and debt

risks.title: Litigation Risks

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations may impact the company's operations

ai_positioning.summary: PayPal integrates AI and machine learning into its operations and products to enhance customer experience and efficiency. The company is investing in these technologies to innovate and remain competitive in the payments market.
evidence: The Company is investing in artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhance its products and services.
Artificial intelligence and machine learning are critical to our strategy for developing new products and improving existing ones.
We are leveraging AI and ML to personalize customer experiences, detect fraud, and optimize our operations.
